## Vakint four-loop status

The opt-in experimental bridge has passed parent, dotted-parent and pinch
comparisons for H, FG, X and BMW: **twelve finite-target comparisons**. The cold
native tail has an invalid FORM path and performs 26,956 / 3,362 / 82,637 / 16,113
new rule applications respectively for the dotted targets. BMW uses first-slot
power three rather than two to exercise an actual recurrence. Offline FMFT prepares exact
projections for the reached finite terminals. This is not a shipped standalone
four-loop master catalog and does not establish 20,000-digit data.

The existing fourteen analytic four-loop FMFT references plus the actually
four-loop decorated freeform reference passed: **15/15 legacy tests**. These
are not fifteen RustRed acceptance passes. BMW's original power-two targets were
all terminals, so that earlier attempt stopped at the test's required
recurrence-use assertion; the subsequent power-three experiment passed without
weakening that assertion. This is not evidence of arbitrary-index coverage.

The shared FMFT finalizer now expands exact Laurent coefficients before
approximate master substitution. A regression demonstrates the old spurious
floating cancellation, and the missing-order rejection and tolerances remain
unchanged. Requested precision still must be interpreted against supplied
master-table precision; no added arbitrary-precision claim follows from the
IBP generation work.

Full four-loop production admission, the entire numerator/non-unit-mass native
acceptance inventory, complete or explicitly scoped certification, and a
representative FMFT-versus-native speed target remain unfinished. Finite-target
measurements must not be extrapolated to that whole inventory.
